text.p: Swedish beverage can maker PLM said on Monday a fall in demand for beverage cans had hit sales over the summer, adding that profits for 1996 would be lower than in 1995.
"The lower demand is primarily due to the fact that the summer has remained cool in large areas of Europe. The poor weather has meant far lower soft drinks consumption," PLM said in a statement.
Since the can operation is entirely order-driven, production would be adapted to this new situation and a number of temporary production stoppages would be planned in the next quarter, PLM said.
"It means that the result after financial items for 1996 is expected to be somewhat lower than last year's," it said.
In 1995 PLM posted a profit of 519 million crowns after financial net.
